{{Quote|Of all the Dark Jedi that have sworn allegiance to me, you three are the strongest. One of you will have the honor of becoming my new apprentice... if you prove yourself worthy.|[[Darth Malak]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] in [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. When [[Darth Malak]] seized control of the Empire, this Dark Jedi swore allegiance to the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] and was considered by Malak to be one of his three most powerful followers.

==Behind the scenes==
This Dark Jedi appears only in the non-[[canon]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] ending in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', where he is killed by Revan and [[Bastila Shan]]. As this event does not occur in the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' chronology, he is assumed to have lived through the [[Jedi Civil War]].
